result.summary: The page appears largely functional, with no critical visual breakage. The main concerns are minor layout/scroll affordance issues where horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge and some restaurant text is truncated.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the far right after “Healthy,” leaving a partially visible chip with no clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade, spacing, or a horizontal scroll indicator so the cut-off chip clearly signals more content rather than looking accidentally cropped.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you,” the third restaurant card is partially cut off and its name is truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…”.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths/peek padding and ellipsis rules so off-screen cards look intentionally scrollable and titles truncate cleanly.

issues.description: Delivery-time pills overlap the bottom edge of some restaurant images, which can look slightly misaligned on the first card.
issues.suggestion: Keep badges fully inside the image bounds or standardize overlap/offset across all cards.
